items.title: Inflation Hasn’t Disappeared, Yet Chipotle (CMG) Raised Guidance
items.summary: According to the latest economic reading, America’s GDP growth slowed to 1.5% in Q2 from 2.1% in Q1. Meanwhile, headline PCE inflation remained elevated at 3.7% year over year in June, while core PCE inflation stood at 3.3%. items.title: Parasite Outbreak Fears Crush Restaurant Sales Weeks After RFK Jr. Said It Was “Under Control”
items.summary: Three weeks after a Cabinet secretary declared a parasite outbreak under control, a national salad chain collapsed into bankruptcy and a healthy food brand that never even stocked the recalled lettuce watched its stock crater 35 percent.
